_comment: Alterations a won fight hands over for a monster beaten in it, and takes back on a map
monster     the monster whose defeat hands it over
subarea     only when beaten there (0: anywhere)
lostAt      a map where a won fight takes it back (0: never)
LORD CROW'S LIBRARY, as Ankama remade it on 21 January 2025: «Pour chaque monstre unique que
vous affrontez, vous obtenez une altération correspondant à ce dernier. Il faut donc obtenir
les 3 altérations pour continuer le donjon» (Dofus pour les noobs). The three are the client's
632-634 (category 20), «Esta pluma se consiguió después de haber arremetido contra las de…»
each, and Virgil asks for them in the First Room. INFERRED: they go once the master is beaten
in his throne room, so that the next run asks for them again; the guide does not say.

wins.why: Zorio, el Zorrowapo (Rono le Renarbo) leaves the «Pluma de Zorio».
Horacio, el Cuerbok Domesticado (Horace le Corbac Apprivoisé) leaves the «Pluma de Horacio».
Kondonio, el Bebedor (Kapotie le Buveur) leaves the «Pluma de Kondonio».
